title: coap_slot_coord.c conflict path dereferences size_t conflict_cose_len - cannot compile under LICHEN_COAP_SLOT_COORD=y
description: coap_slot_coord.c:1463 declares local 'size_t conflict_cose_len = 0;' (passed by address to process_claim at :1467), but the conflict snapshot guard at :1486-1488 treats it as a pointer: ':1486 conflict_cose_len != NULL' (integer-vs-pointer comparison) and ':1487 *conflict_cose_len > 0' (invalid unary * on size_t) - hard compile error under -Werror. Latent today because CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SLOT_COORD defaults n. Fix: drop the != NULL test on the size_t and use 'conflict_cose_len > 0' directly (matching :486-488 producer semantics). Found by security codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-1jl1; verified by direct read.
